title: Observe European property masks in headgear inventory
changes: Document a source-backed ordinary headgear scene that reads the e100 property masks.
validation: Authenticated original Wine source windows and ran one retained 560-frame Wine observation: 91 typed reads and 364 source bytes, with 224 guarded files and 707 frozen sources unchanged.
limitations: Aggregate counters do not identify distinct source bytes or exact PCs; a same-scene comparison, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
